# Yurafy - AI-Powered Business Automation Platform

## About Yurafy
Yurafy is a cutting-edge technology platform dedicated to empowering businesses of all sizes with AI-driven automation solutions. We combine artificial intelligence, automation, and expert web development to deliver intelligent solutions that streamline operations, increase sales, and save valuable time.

## Core Features
- AI-Powered Content Generation: Generate instant, high-quality product descriptions and marketing copy
- WhatsApp Business Automation: Automate customer interactions, order confirmations, and marketing campaigns
- Custom Web Store Development: Professional, responsive websites with SEO optimization
- AI WhatsApp Agent: Intelligent 24/7 customer support with natural language understanding
- Business Automation: Connect apps, social media, and communication channels into seamless workflows

## Pricing Plans
- Free: Test all features with limited usage (5 products, 10 orders)
- Starter: $11/month - Basic store setup with branding and domain (50 products)
- WhatsApp Automation: $11/month - Automate messaging with WhatsApp Cloud API (500 contacts)
- AI WhatsApp Agent: $21/month - Automation + AI-powered assistant (1000 contacts)
- Pro Seller: $25/month - Starter + WhatsApp Automation (500 products, 2000 contacts)
- Visionary: $50/month - All features, unlimited products, AI agent, custom CSS/JS
